registryBasis: The Municipalidad Provincial de Arequipa lists its urban-development and tax-registration units, including local predial records and property-sector maps. SUNARP’s official government publication records a 2024 agreement specifically with the provincial municipality to provide municipal access to registered-property polygons from the Base Gráfica Registral. The agreement is municipal/institutional access, not an anonymous public feed.

searchQueries.query: Arequipa Peru official municipal cadastre registered parcel polygons SUNARP registry
searchQueries.scope: Find primary city-local registry/cadastre basis and safe anonymous polygon routes.
searchQueries.result: SUNARP’s government publication documents a 2024 interinstitutional agreement with the Municipalidad Provincial de Arequipa to allow the municipality to view, extract and download registered-property polygons within its jurisdiction. The agreement is institutional access; no public geometry endpoint was identified. The municipal directory lists development and tax-registration offices; no tax lookup was used.

searchQueries.result: La publicación oficial de SUNARP registra un convenio con la Municipalidad Provincial de Arequipa para que el municipio visualice, extraiga y descargue polígonos de predios inscritos de su ámbito.
